data.description: Per-section background parallax. Writes a `--aed-parallax-y` CSS variable on scroll that the section's CSS can use to translate its background. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

data-aed-parallax.description: Scroll-to-translate ratio (0–1). 0 = no movement, 1 = moves at scroll speed.

data-aed-parallax-max.description: Maximum translation in pixels (clamps the effect on long sections).
